mapper.select: SELECT r.*, s.name AS stationName FROM vp_cycle_report r LEFT JOIN station_info s ON r.station_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted = 0
SELECT name FROM station_info WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT s.name AS stationName, COALESCE(ips.parkingCount, 0) AS parkingCount, COALESCE(er.passCount, 0) AS passCount, COALESCE(ROUND(ips.parkingCount / NULLIF(s.space_count, 0) * 100, 2), 0) AS spaceUseRate FROM station_info s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT station_id, COUNT(*) AS parkingCount FROM in_park_status WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = '正常' GROUP BY station_id ) ips ON s.id = ips.station_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT station_id, COUNT(*) AS passCount FROM enter_record WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY station_id ) er ON s.id = er.station_id WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
AND s.id = #{stationId}

SELECT s.name AS stationName, COALESCE(er.enterCount, 0) + COALESCE(lr.leaveCount, 0) AS passCount, COALESCE(al.abnormalCount, 0) AS abnormalCount, COALESCE(pr.etcCount, 0) AS etcPassCount FROM station_info s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT station_id, COUNT(*) AS enterCount FROM enter_record WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY station_id ) er ON s.id = er.station_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT station_id, COUNT(*) AS leaveCount FROM leave_record WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY station_id ) lr ON s.id = lr.station_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT station_id, COUNT(*) AS abnormalCount FROM abnormal_leave WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY station_id ) al ON s.id = al.station_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT station_id, COUNT(*) AS etcCount FROM pass_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND pass_reason = 'ETC' GROUP BY station_id ) pr ON s.id = pr.station_id WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
AND s.id = #{stationId}
